name: Hippodraco
sum: A small iguanodontian from the Early Cretaceous Cedar Mountain Formation of Utah, known from an immature individual.
wsnote: The holotype is immature; no adult size is given.
holotype: UMNH VP 20208, a partial skeleton of an immature individual from the Cedar Mountain Formation, Utah.
biology: Not described in the sources consulted.
author: McDonald et al. 2010
